description: Generate a honeypot spam trap for a web form: the hidden field HTML, the CSS that moves it off-screen, and the server check that quietly rejects submissions where it is filled. Platforms: php, node (Express), python (Flask), cloudflare (Pages Function), netlify (Netlify Forms netlify-honeypot attribute) and formspree (its fixed _gotcha field). An optional time trap rejects forms sent faster than minSeconds; it needs JavaScript and does not apply to netlify or formspree. Warns when the field name is one browsers might autofill. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/honeypot-field-generator/

className.description: CSS class that hides the field off-screen

fieldName.description: Name of the hidden decoy field (letters, numbers, - and _, up to 40 characters). Ignored for formspree, which always uses _gotcha

minSeconds.description: Fastest allowed time to fill the form, in seconds

timeTrap.description: Also reject forms sent faster than minSeconds (adds a small script)
